plugin.name: ryoku-decor
plugin._long: Rounds window corners and draws border rings and shadows.

option.name: corner_power
option._long: Superellipse exponent used for rounded corners.

option.name: border_width
option._long: Width of the border ring in logical pixels.

option.name: active_color
option._long: Border colour for the focused window.

option.name: shadow_enabled
option._long: Draw a soft shadow behind each window.

option.name: shadow_radius
option._long: Soft shadow extent in logical pixels.

option.name: shadow_spread
option._long: Amount by which the shadow box grows before its soft edge.

option.name: shadow_offset_x
option._long: Horizontal shadow offset in logical pixels.

option.name: shadow_offset_y
option._long: Vertical shadow offset in logical pixels.

option.name: shadow_color
option._long: Colour and opacity of the window shadow.

option.name: ignore_views
option._long: View-matcher criteria for windows that should remain undecorated.
